about: The 16 core-locale keys that the merge of integrate/wave3 (0346ee1) brought in (src/i18n/locales/*.ts), checked in all 15 languages with branch lang/qa-pipeline's tools as they stand at fa198bc (scripts/lang: check.mjs, glossary.mjs, grammar.mjs with LanguageTool 6.6 and Hunspell, backtranslate.py with MADLAD-400 + MiniLM + LaBSE, meaning.mjs), run on a scratch merge of fa198bc with 0346ee1 (qa-pipeline's text for every older key, the integration's for the 16 new ones). The only change to the tools was a sample value for {lines} in lib/strings.mjs, which they had none for. 'reading' is the engineer's own reading (a language model, not a native speaker). This branch does not edit the core locale (its brief); 'proposal' is a suggested new text in lang/qa-pipeline's apply.mjs format, checked by the same tools (proposalCheck).
